dedupe_keys.name: bio 3d indoor outdoor benchmark dataset for lod3 building point cloud semantic segmentation

description: BIO is a benchmark of 100 building models with indoor and outdoor geometry, delivered as point clouds and meshes whose structural elements are labelled in 11 semantic classes that follow IFC and CityGML, for training semantic segmentation of buildings at LoD3 detail. It was produced by Yuwei Cao (University of British Columbia) and Marco Scaioni (Politecnico di Milano) from existing polygonal models of commercial, residential, industrial and institutional buildings, and tested with one machine-learning and four deep-learning methods. Coverage is the 100 modelled buildings, not a place. Access: one 3.4 GB tar archive on Zenodo, published 20 October 2025. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: data are generated from polygon models, not scanned, so sensor noise and occlusion differ from real surveys. Simulation uses: training models that turn scans into semantically rich building models for digital twins, energy and structural analyses. Related records: the DFC23 roof-type benchmark and 3DBAG.
name: BIO: 3D indoor-outdoor benchmark dataset for LoD3 building point cloud semantic segmentation
provider: University of British Columbia and Politecnico di Milano (Yuwei Cao, Marco Scaioni)

sources.note: Authors and affiliations, 100 buildings, 11 IFC/CityGML classes, file size, CC BY 4.0, date 2025-10-20
